messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature

message.content:
The “sweet spot” for visiting Hawaii is typically **late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October)**.  

| Month | Why it’s great |
|-------|----------------|
| **April** | Warm, sunny weather (average highs ~80 °F / 27 °C), fewer tourists than summer, and plenty of local festivals. |
| **May** | Similar weather, slightly higher prices than April but still lower than peak summer; great for beach‑and‑hike combos. |
| **September** | Post‑summer crowds thin out, temperatures stay comfortable (~80 °F), and you can catch the tail end of the summer surf season. |
| **October** | Cooler evenings, still warm days, and the best deals on flights and accommodations as the high‑season rush ends. |

### Quick temperature snapshot (Hawaii – Honolulu)

| Month | Avg. High | Avg. Low |
|-------|-----------|----------|
| April | 81 °F (27 °C) | 66 °F (19 °C) |
| May | 82 °F (28 °C) | 67 °F (19 °C) |
| September | 83 °F (28 °C) | 68 °F (20 °C) |
| October | 81 °F (27 °C) | 66 °F (19 °C) |

*(These averages come from NOAA’s climate data for Honolulu.)*

If you’re looking for the lowest crowds and the best value, aim for **April–May** or **September–October**. If you don’t mind a bit more traffic and higher prices, the peak winter months (December–January) are also excellent for sunny weather and holiday festivities.
